advice.caption: Each asset class as a share of the invested value, against the band your profile allows. The gap is what would have to move to land on the target — negative means selling. Worst drift first.
advice.inBalance: Every asset class is inside its band. Nothing to do.
advice.profileLine: Measured against the {{profile}} profile, over <money>{{invested}}</money> invested.
advice.title: Target allocation
advice.unavailable: There is nothing invested to measure a profile against yet. Sync Ghostfolio and this section fills in.

unmapped.hint: These are left out of every figure above rather than counted against a band that was never set for them. Give them a band, or check how Ghostfolio classifies them.
unmapped.title: Held in classes your profile has no band for

chart.allocationSummary_one: One asset class: {{top}}, {{share}} of the portfolio.
chart.allocationSummary_other: Allocation across {{value}} asset classes; the largest is {{top}} at {{share}}.
chart.netWorthSummary: Net worth between {{from}} and {{to}}: {{start}} at the start, {{end}} at the end.
chart.valueSummary: Market value between {{from}} and {{to}}: {{start}} at the start, {{end}} at the end.

dedupe.hint: This account exists in both tools; only the source of truth counts toward net worth.
dedupe.title: Counted once

metric.cashHint: Uninvested money sitting at the broker. It is the same balance your bank shows, counted once.
metric.emergencyFundHint: How long the liquid balance would cover an average month.
metric.investedHint: Positions only, which is what the allocation below is a picture of.
metric.twrHint: Return on the money while it was invested, unaffected by when you paid in.

fund.meta_one: TER {{ter}} · the only fund in your list for this class
fund.meta_other: TER {{ter}} · one of {{value}} funds in your list for this class

funding.cash: Out of cash, which also moves the total these shares are shares of — so it takes more than the gap to close the gap.
funding.paired: Paired with the trade on the other side, so the invested total does not move and the amount is the gap itself.

suggest.lede: One trade per class that left its band, each with the drift that motivates it and what the beurstaks would come to.
suggest.none: Nothing worth trading: every class is inside its band, or the correction falls under your own thresholds.

omits.capitalGains: Capital gains are not in this figure: what you owe depends on what you paid, and Balancr never sees a cost base.

position.meta_one: <money>{{held}}</money> held · the only position in this class
position.meta_other: <money>{{held}}</money> held · one of {{value}} positions in this class
position.unnamed: A position the snapshot does not name

skipped.belowMinTrade: {{name}} is {{outside}} past its edge, but closing it takes only <money>{{amount}}</money> — under the <money2>{{floor}}</money2> you set as the smallest trade worth making.
skipped.insideTolerance: {{name}} is {{outside}} past its edge, inside the {{tolerance}} you allow before acting. <money>{{amount}}</money> would close it.
skipped.title: Outside its band, and left alone

tax.none: No tax rule prices this trade.

suggest.title: What would bring it back

unavailable.noFundInUniverse: Nothing in your fund list covers this class, so there is no instrument to name. Add one to the fund universe and this becomes a suggestion.
unavailable.notHeld: This class is over its ceiling, but no holding is labelled with it — so there is no position to sell.
unavailable.unknown: No instrument could be named for this class.

assumption.debtClaims: Assumes the fund's debt-claim share from its asset class, not from a published figure.
assumption.fullExemption: Assumes none of this year's exempt tranche has been used yet.

basis.rateOnly: {{rate}} of an amount that is not known yet

caveat.transcribed: These rates were transcribed from published guidance and nobody has checked them against the law: {{rules}}. Confirm them before acting on the amount.

todo.distribution: Depends on whether the share class pays out its income or reinvests it.
todo.fsmaRegistered: Depends on whether this share class is registered for public distribution in Belgium — record `fsma_registered` for it in the fund universe.
todo.interestComponent: Depends on the interest component the fund publishes in its Belgian TIS.
